entities.name: Zenon
entities.description: Setessan member of Kytheon Iora's irregulars who wore a green cloak and was killed with the other irregulars.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: Leader of the irregulars; threw Heliod's spear.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City defended against harpies and cyclopses.

events.summary: Zenon is part of the defense of Akros against harpies and cyclopses.
events.quote: Zenon was later part of the defense of Akros against harpies and cyclopses

events.summary: Zenon is killed along with the other irregulars when Erebos returns Heliod's spear thrown by Kytheon.
events.quote: He was killed along with the other irregulars when Heliod 's spear thrown by Kytheon was returned by Erebos

relations.note: He was one of Kytheon's irregulars.
relations.quote: Zenon was one of Kytheon Iora 's irregulars
